    The limit step of Satz 5.1 #

    If the stage killing all lifts of the αᵢ is good, then so is every stage restoring finitely many points (good_finite, by good_step). Every path of the cover lives in such a stage (exists_finset_avoids), so the cover is cycle-free; and for d on a path from a to c, Lemma 5.2 in a stage containing that path and a fixed path W : a ⇝ c gives a chain from d to a point of W. Chains have bounded length, and the head of a chain lies in a ball around its last target (chain_head_mem_ball), so the interval [a, c] is finite (coverGood_limit).

    IsChain o l → ∀ (h : l ≠ []), (l.head h).snd.fst ∈ ball (l.getLast h).snd.fst (2 * l.length)
